bio: Will 1761 (NY Wills VI, Liber 23, p. 130): asked for burial 'decent without Pomp or State'; named Joshua Brown executor; witnesses John Brewster, Samuel Smith and Selah Strong. (Not the same as Daniel Tuthill 1743–1800, SAR P-308220.)
sources: Abstracts of Wills, NYHS vol. VI, Liber 23 p. 130, https://archive.org/details/abstractswillso05kellgoog
